en.text: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.

zhSimplified.text: 行为纯正的贫穷人 胜过乖谬愚妄的富足人。

zhTraditional.text: 行為純正的貧窮人 勝過乖謬愚妄的富足人。

en.text: It isn’t good to have zeal without knowledge, nor to be hasty with one’s feet and miss the way.

zhSimplified.text: 心无知识的，乃为不善； 脚步急快的，难免犯罪。

zhTraditional.text: 心無知識的，乃為不善； 腳步急快的，難免犯罪。

en.text: The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 人的愚昧倾败他的道； 他的心也抱怨耶和华。

zhTraditional.text: 人的愚昧傾敗他的道； 他的心也抱怨耶和華。

en.text: Wealth adds many friends, but the poor is separated from his friend.

zhSimplified.text: 财物使朋友增多； 但穷人朋友远离。

zhTraditional.text: 財物使朋友增多； 但窮人朋友遠離。

en.text: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.

zhSimplified.text: 作假见证的，必不免受罚； 吐出谎言的，终不能逃脱。

zhTraditional.text: 作假見證的，必不免受罰； 吐出謊言的，終不能逃脫。

en.text: Many will entreat the favor of a ruler, and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts.

zhSimplified.text: 好施散的，有多人求他的恩情； 爱送礼的，人都为他的朋友。

zhTraditional.text: 好施散的，有多人求他的恩情； 愛送禮的，人都為他的朋友。

en.text: All the relatives of the poor shun him; how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas, but they are gone.

zhSimplified.text: 贫穷人，弟兄都恨他； 何况他的朋友，更远离他！ 他用言语追随，他们却走了。

zhTraditional.text: 貧窮人，弟兄都恨他； 何況他的朋友，更遠離他！ 他用言語追隨，他們卻走了。

en.text: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul. He who keeps understanding shall find good.

zhSimplified.text: 得着智慧的，爱惜生命； 保守聪明的，必得好处。

zhTraditional.text: 得着智慧的，愛惜生命； 保守聰明的，必得好處。

en.text: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish.

zhSimplified.text: 作假见证的，不免受罚； 吐出谎言的，也必灭亡。

zhTraditional.text: 作假見證的，不免受罰； 吐出謊言的，也必滅亡。

en.text: Delicate living is not appropriate for a fool, much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

zhSimplified.text: 愚昧人宴乐度日是不合宜的； 何况仆人管辖王子呢？

zhTraditional.text: 愚昧人宴樂度日是不合宜的； 何況僕人管轄王子呢？

en.text: The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.

zhSimplified.text: 人有见识就不轻易发怒； 宽恕人的过失便是自己的荣耀。

zhTraditional.text: 人有見識就不輕易發怒； 寬恕人的過失便是自己的榮耀。

en.text: The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.

zhSimplified.text: 王的忿怒好像狮子吼叫； 他的恩典却如草上的甘露。

zhTraditional.text: 王的忿怒好像獅子吼叫； 他的恩典卻如草上的甘露。

en.text: A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.

zhSimplified.text: 愚昧的儿子是父亲的祸患； 妻子的争吵如雨连连滴漏。

zhTraditional.text: 愚昧的兒子是父親的禍患； 妻子的爭吵如雨連連滴漏。

en.text: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 房屋钱财是祖宗所遗留的； 惟有贤慧的妻是耶和华所赐的。

zhTraditional.text: 房屋錢財是祖宗所遺留的； 惟有賢慧的妻是耶和華所賜的。

en.text: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.

zhSimplified.text: 懒惰使人沉睡； 懈怠的人必受饥饿。

zhTraditional.text: 懶惰使人沉睡； 懈怠的人必受飢餓。

en.text: He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, but he who is contemptuous in his ways shall die.

zhSimplified.text: 谨守诫命的，保全生命； 轻忽己路的，必致死亡。

zhTraditional.text: 謹守誡命的，保全生命； 輕忽己路的，必致死亡。

en.text: He who has pity on the poor lends to the LORD; he will reward him.

zhSimplified.text: 怜悯贫穷的，就是借给耶和华； 他的善行，耶和华必偿还。

zhTraditional.text: 憐憫貧窮的，就是借給耶和華； 他的善行，耶和華必償還。

en.text: Discipline your son, for there is hope; don’t be a willing party to his death.

zhSimplified.text: 趁有指望，管教你的儿子； 你的心不可任他死亡。

zhTraditional.text: 趁有指望，管教你的兒子； 你的心不可任他死亡。

en.text: A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty, for if you rescue him, you must do it again.

zhSimplified.text: 暴怒的人必受刑罚； 你若救他，必须再救。

zhTraditional.text: 暴怒的人必受刑罰； 你若救他，必須再救。

en.text: Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.

zhSimplified.text: 你要听劝教，受训诲， 使你终久有智慧。

zhTraditional.text: 你要聽勸教，受訓誨， 使你終久有智慧。

en.text: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but the LORD’s counsel will prevail.

zhSimplified.text: 人心多有计谋； 惟有耶和华的筹算才能立定。

zhTraditional.text: 人心多有計謀； 惟有耶和華的籌算才能立定。

en.text: That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar.

zhSimplified.text: 施行仁慈的，令人爱慕； 穷人强如说谎言的。

zhTraditional.text: 施行仁慈的，令人愛慕； 窮人強如說謊言的。

en.text: The fear of the LORD leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.

zhSimplified.text: 敬畏耶和华的，得着生命； 他必恒久知足，不遭祸患。

zhTraditional.text: 敬畏耶和華的，得着生命； 他必恆久知足，不遭禍患。

en.text: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.

zhSimplified.text: 懒惰人放手在盘子里， 就是向口撤回，他也不肯。

zhTraditional.text: 懶惰人放手在盤子裏， 就是向口撤回，他也不肯。

en.text: Flog a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke one who has understanding, and he will gain knowledge.

zhSimplified.text: 鞭打亵慢人，愚蒙人必长见识； 责备明哲人，他就明白知识。

zhTraditional.text: 鞭打褻慢人，愚蒙人必長見識； 責備明哲人，他就明白知識。

en.text: He who robs his father and drives away his mother is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.

zhSimplified.text: 虐待父亲、撵出母亲的， 是贻羞致辱之子。

zhTraditional.text: 虐待父親、攆出母親的， 是貽羞致辱之子。

en.text: If you stop listening to instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge.

zhSimplified.text: 我儿，不可听了教训 而又偏离知识的言语。

zhTraditional.text: 我兒，不可聽了教訓 而又偏離知識的言語。

en.text: A corrupt witness mocks justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down iniquity.

zhSimplified.text: 匪徒作见证戏笑公平； 恶人的口吞下罪孽。

zhTraditional.text: 匪徒作見證戲笑公平； 惡人的口吞下罪孽。

en.text: Penalties are prepared for scoffers, and beatings for the backs of fools.

zhSimplified.text: 刑罚是为亵慢人预备的； 鞭打是为愚昧人的背预备的。

zhTraditional.text: 刑罰是為褻慢人預備的； 鞭打是為愚昧人的背預備的。
